svg.title: A digital twin of a supermarket chain, built on the ontology
svg.desc: A 3D platform diagram. In the middle, the digital twin: farms, a distribution centre, a truck route, a store, pallets, an operations lead and a supplier contract, joined by relations such as supplies, loads and delivers. The truck route is marked as the bottleneck. Below, connectors and Eunomia's memory feed it through bundles of cables. Above, AI agents, what-if runs and reports read from it.

g.text: One live model of the business
